items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: Charlie played a nice trombone...incidentally...he played with Sharky...years ago...back at the Frolic...

ctx.x: Yeah...Charlie...Charlie Miller...yeah...and Philly...Philly and Teddy were brothers... Uh-huh...Charlie played a nice trombone...incidentally...he played with Sharky...years ago...back at the Frolic...
When did the Frolic open up anyhow?
